title: CBOR is the wire format; JSON is optional
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 5. Step 4 — Serialise as CBOR; HCERT Specification, 3.2.7 Health Certificate Claim.

statements.label: CBOR is the wire format; JSON is optional
statements.requirement: The library SHALL work entirely on in-memory structures and CBOR. It SHALL NOT need a JSON representation to issue or verify. A JSON view of payloads MAY be provided for display and debugging.

sources.quote: the wire format is CBOR, and an implementation need never produce the JSON form at all.
